claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrival event. There is no trace for this trip at all: EV-GPS-00213 carries status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so not one fix places the driver anywhere at any time. No limb (b) can be made out, and POL-NS-01 says in terms that where any of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable. The $6 cannot stand on this record.

The rider's case does not depend on denying the trip record. Limb (a) is met by the arrived event at 17:47:05 in EV-TRIP-00213, and limb (d) is met by a driver termination at 17:53:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE. The charge nonetheless fails, because limbs (b) and (c) are GPS tests and the GPS trace is the one artifact the platform did not produce (EV-GPS-00213, MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT).

POL-NS-02 is the arrival test, and it needs at least three consecutive fixes at 25 m accuracy or better inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius set by fee_schedule. With the trace absent (EV-GPS-00213, MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) there is not a single qualifying in-radius fix, and the clause directs that where no qualifying in-radius fix exists in the 15 minutes before cancellation the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The driver's own statement that he was at the bay from about 5.47 to 5.53 is a party assertion; POL-NS-02 requires fixes, not assertions.

Even reading the arrived marker at 17:47:05 and the cancellation at 17:53:40 as a 395-second hold, POL-NS-01 limb (c) measures the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly not from the arrived event. There is no qualifying fix anywhere on this record, so the required dwell is unestablished and limb (c) fails alongside limb (b). The platform may not substitute its own arrival marker for the measurement the clause prescribes.

POL-NS-05 limb (ii) applies on the face of the record: where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event in the ruling's referrals list. The only trace for this trip is EV-GPS-00213, which is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the record contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere. The refund is owed and the false-arrival referral should be recorded.

Nothing in the advisory record rescues the hold. EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the Jurong East interchange in this window. POL-NS-06 only permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed where a populated KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covers the pickup road and the waiting period, so no advisory event extends or excuses the hold here, and the effective in-geofence dwell cannot be computed at all, let alone shown to reach the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum.

The rider says she messaged the driver three times, and EV-TRIP-00213 corroborates that a chat existed — chat_message_count of 3 — but the chat log itself is gone: EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (c) therefore cannot be run, and under POL-NS-04 an undecidable limb (c) is neutral rather than failed. Where POL-NS-04 does not apply the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01, where the missing trace defeats the charge. Neither side's account of the messages can be verified, and no adverse finding may be built against the rider out of a log the platform lost.

Both profiles record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 2 — two prior no-show disputes between this same rider (RDR-07690) and this same driver (DRV-04355) in the trailing 90 days, exactly the repetition the rider describes in her claim. POL-NS-09 limb (c) is engaged on the plain figures, and escalation under that clause is terminal: no monetary ruling issues and the disputed fee is held rather than collected. At the very least the $6 must not be taken from the rider while the question is unanswered.

The decisive facts — whether the driver reached the pin and how long he held there — are carried by no admissible artifact at all. Under POL-GEN-02 the confidence in a ruling cannot exceed the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, and a MISSING artifact (EV-GPS-00213, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) can carry no fact. A finding that the fee stands would rest on nothing and could not approach the 0.70 confidence floor; POL-NS-09 requires escalation rather than a monetary ruling on that footing.

The fee is still PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 in EV-FARE-00213. On this rider-filed dispute, POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative: it would leave the $6 charge exactly where it is, against the rider. The rider's claim should not be disposed of as unsupported when the reason the arrival test cannot be run is the platform's own telemetry gaps; the outcomes that do not leave the rider carrying the disputed charge are a refund, or an escalation that holds the fee.

POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied: limbs (b) and (c) fail for want of any GPS trace (EV-GPS-00213, MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). No driver compensation is payable on this record, and the driver's statement that he still wants the fee does not create an entitlement the policy does not give him.

claims.text: The rider's only route to a refund is POL-NS-04, and it cannot be run on this record. The chat log is a MISSING artifact (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so limb (a) - that she sent a locating or coordinating message - and limb (b) - that the driver failed to reply within 120 seconds - are both undecidable. A missing artifact carries no fact: her assertion that she messaged three times is corroborated by nothing, while the driver's statement that he answered every message stands uncontradicted and is consistent with trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 and an empty in_app_calls list. Where limbs (a) and (b) cannot be established, POL-NS-04 does not apply and nothing displaces the fee on that footing.

The trip record is the one artifact that survived - COMPLETE, causally ordered, weight 1.0 - and it supplies the two limbs of POL-NS-01 that do not depend on GPS: limb (a), a driver 'arrived' event at 17:47:05, and limb (d), termination by the driver at 17:53:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three reasons POL-NS-01(d) names. The interval from the arrival marker to the cancellation is 6.6 minutes (wait_time_min 6.6), comfortably past the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and the record shows the rider, not the driver, as the party who could not be reached.

Every clause that could displace this fee turns on the same absent trace. The gps_trace is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so POL-NS-02's in-radius fix test, POL-NS-05's false-arrival test and POL-NS-06's effective-dwell computation are each uncomputable. Nothing in the record places the driver outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius or shows him in motion at 15 km/h or more, and the rider cannot convert a platform telemetry outage into affirmative proof that the driver never arrived. A clause cannot be run against an artifact that does not exist, and no limb of POL-NS-01 is affirmatively failed - the limbs are simply undecidable.

POL-NS-06's only accumulation route, sub-limb (i), requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated with a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road. The sole advisory artifact is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so that limb is unavailable and no separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. Nothing on this record shows that holding position at the Jurong East PHV bay was lawfully impossible, and the shortfall case the rider needs cannot be built.

The amount itself is not defective, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. That limb requires fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee to reconcile with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: TRANSPORT_HUB at SGD 6.00 against RYDE_X at SGD 4.00 yields SGD 6.00, exactly the 6.00 itemised, with a difference of 0.00. The rider's complaint that the charge is unexplained is answered by the fee schedule itself, and the greater-of rule is the dimension that produced the figure.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 terminations against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 107 is 2.8 per cent, below the 8 per cent ratio. There is accordingly no ground to withhold compensation or to escalate under POL-NS-09(d), and the only profile fields the anti-farming test names point away from any pattern of farming.

This is the third no-show dispute between this same rider and this same driver inside 90 days: both profiles record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 2, which meets the POL-NS-09(c) trigger of 2 or more no-show disputes between the same pair. On a record where the arrival and dwell limbs are undecidable only because the driver's own trace never reached the platform, the correct channel is escalation, which places the disputed fee on hold rather than refunding it - and a full refund is the one outcome the record does not support, because no clause that would produce it can be run.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and the driver: this dispute goes to a human reviewer, and the disputed $6.00 cancellation fee is held — not collected from the rider and not refunded — until that review is complete. POL-NS-09 escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary ruling, so no amount is awarded or refunded today (amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd are null). The merits themselves cannot be decided on this record: the deciding facts — whether the driver reached the Jurong East PHV bay pin and held the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum dwell — are carried by the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT): no fix places either party anywhere at any time. Under POL-NS-01 the GPS limbs (b) and (c) cannot be run, and POL-NS-02's proximity test and POL-NS-06's dwell computation read the same missing trace. On the rider's full-refund claims (POL-NS-01(b), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05(ii)): not accepted as a money outcome. An absent artifact leaves the limb undecided, not affirmatively failed — POL-NS-02's 'no qualifying in-radius fix' presupposes a trace that exists and can be read, and POL-NS-05's false-arrival test needs the trace to place the driver more than 300 m from the pin or moving at 15 km/h or more, which the missing trace establishes neither way. Limb (b) is therefore undecided rather than failed, and no self-executing refund arises; that open question is exactly what the reviewer must settle. On the driver's claims that the charge stands (POL-NS-01(a) arrived event 17:47:05, limb (d) RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination 17:53:40, wait_time_min 6.6 past the 300-second minimum): the trip record does supply limbs (a) and (d) (EV-TRIP-00213, weight 1.0), but it cannot substitute for the GPS measurement that limbs (b) and (c) require, so POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and the fee cannot be confirmed. The driver's account that he was at the bay from about 5.47 to 5.53 (counterparty statement) is noted, but POL-NS-02 reads GPS fixes, not assertions. Chat: EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) while trip_record.chat_message_count = 3 shows a log existed; POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) cannot be run and an undecidable limb (c) is neutral, so neither the rider's 'three messages, no reply' nor the driver's 'I answered every message' can be verified and no adverse finding is built on the lost log. Fare: not defective — $6.00 is the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so it reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (difference 0.00) and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Advisory: EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-NS-06's accumulation route is unavailable and nothing extends or excuses the hold. Compensation: POL-NS-07's anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d = 3 (below 4) and 3/107 = 2.8% (below 8%) — but no driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full. Under POL-GEN-02 the MISSING artifacts carry no fact and cannot lift confidence; the escalation trigger itself rests on the two independent weight-1.0 profiles, so confidence is 0.9. Open question for the reviewer: obtain the driver's device trace and the chat log, then determine whether the driver arrived within the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius and held at least 300 seconds, and whether the two prior same-pair disputes indicate a pattern. No referral is recorded because no clause in this policy set directs an instruction into the escalation packet on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
Escalated to human review under POL-NS-09. The $6.00 cancellation fee stays on hold — it is neither collected from you nor refunded — until a reviewer decides this case.

WHAT IS NOT IN DISPUTE. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00213, weight_multiplier 1.0) shows the driver marked 'arrived' at 17:47:05 and terminated at 17:53:40 on the code RIDER_UNREACHABLE; the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00213, weight_multiplier 1.0) itemises $6.00. That amount is arithmetically right: the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so $6.00 governs and the difference is $0.00. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute goes to a human reviewer. No money moves now — the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee on TRP-00213 stays on hold (the fare record shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00), neither collected from the rider nor refunded to her.

Why the case must escalate. Two separate POL-NS-09 grounds are met. (c) Both profiles record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 2 — two prior no-show disputes between this same rider (RDR-07690) and this same driver (DRV-04355) in the trailing 90 days — which is the '2 or more' the clause names. (e) The only evidence that could decide whether the driver reached the pickup pin and held there is the driver's GPS trace, EV-GPS-00213, and that artifact is absent: status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is citable but can carry no fact, and no other artifact can carry that fact.

What the record does and does not settle. The trip record EV-TRIP-00213 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) establishes two of the four POL-NS-01 conditions: the 'arrived' event at 17:47:05 (limb a) and the driver's termination at 17:53:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE (limb d), with a recorded wait of 6.6 minutes. Limbs (b) and (c) are GPS measurements — whether the driver was inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, and whether he held there for the 300-second minimum — and with no trace they cannot be run. An absent artifact is the limiting case of an impaired one, so (b) and (c) are undecided, not failed: they support neither the charge nor a refund. I therefore reject the rider's reading of POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05(ii) that a missing trace counts as 'no qualifying in-geofence fix', which would give a full refund of the 6.00 and a false-arrival record. A test that finds nothing must first be able to run; the absence escalates on those clauses' own terms rather than exonerating anyone, so no false-arrival referral is recorded. The same reasoning disposes of the rider's POL-NS-06 point about the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00213-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0): no advisory is needed, because no dwell can be computed at all.

What survives of each side's case. The driver is right that nothing in this record places him outside the arrival radius or in motion, that the rider's account of three messages cannot be tested against the missing chat log EV-CHAT-00213 (MISSING, weight 0.0; trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 shows a log existed, and in_app_calls is empty), and that POL-NS-04 cannot be run on that log in either direction. He is also right that the fee itself is sound: the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee (6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (4.00) is 6.00, exactly the itemised cancellation fee, difference 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. But the fee still cannot be made chargeable: POL-NS-07 pays a driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. The anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d of 3 is below 4, and 3 against completed_trips_30d of 107 is 2.8%, below 8% — so no compensation is payable on this record, and the driver's wish to keep the fee does not create an entitlement the policy does not give him.

Confidence. The escalation is carried by the two profile artifacts supplying the POL-NS-09(c) figures, each COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and independent of one another, so the cap is 1.0; I record 0.9. Any ruling on the merits themselves would rest on the absent trace and could not reach the 0.70 floor, which is a further reason the automated pipeline issues no money ruling here.

Open question for the reviewer: whether the driver was in fact inside the Jurong East PHV bay arrival radius and held there for the full 300 seconds on 11 August, and how the platform's failure to retain either the GPS trace or the chat log should be resolved as between the parties. Under POL-NS-09 the packet carries both briefs, the admissibility pre-pass report, the clause IDs relied on and this reasoning.

This dispute goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now. The $6.00 cancellation fee in EV-FARE-00213 (payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) stays on hold — not collected from the rider, not refunded to her, and no driver compensation paid — until the reviewer decides it.

Why escalation is mandatory. POL-NS-09(c) sends a case to review where the profiles together show two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. EV-RPROF-00213 (RDR-07690) and EV-DPROF-00213 (DRV-04355) each record disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 2 — the "same driver as the last two times" the rider describes. That trigger is engaged, and escalation under POL-NS-09 is TERMINAL: it replaces any monetary ruling. The escalation claims of both advocates (rider, citing POL-NS-09 and POL-GEN-02; driver, citing POL-NS-09) are accepted. POL-NS-09(e) reinforces the same outcome: the only thing that could carry the arrival and dwell facts is the absent driver trace. Because the deciding fact for escalation — the pair's dispute count — is carried by two independent weight-1.0 artifacts, confidence is not capped below the floor.

Why the rider is not refunded. The rider asks for a full refund under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. Every one of those tests reads the GPS trace, and there is no trace: EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; EV-CHAT-00213 (chat log, 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and EV-ADVIS-00213-01 (traffic advisory, 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) are absent on the same terms. A missing artifact carries no fact, and its absence is not an affirmative finding that the driver was never at the pin. So POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), POL-NS-02's in-radius fix test, POL-NS-05's false-arrival test and POL-NS-06's dwell computation are undecided, not failed, and an undecided limb supports neither a refund nor a charge. Those refund claims are rejected. The rider's POL-NS-04 exoneration claim is rejected too: with the chat log absent, limbs (a) and (b) cannot be run at all, so no exoneration arises — and, equally, no adverse finding is built against the rider out of a log the platform itself lost.

Why the fee is not confirmed either. The driver asks the fee to stand under POL-NS-01 and compensation under POL-NS-07. EV-TRIP-00213 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) does supply limbs (a) and (d) — an 'arrived' event at 17:47:05 and a driver termination at 17:53:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE — but limbs (b) and (c) are precisely the GPS tests that cannot be run on an absent trace, so POL-NS-01 is not "satisfied in full" and no POL-NS-07 compensation arises. The driver's own statement that he was at the bay from about 5.47 to 5.53 is evidence, but a party account is not the qualifying-fix measurement the clause requires, and it cannot substitute for the missing instrument.

Points that do not change the result. POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged: the 6.00 fee equals the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee (6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (4.00), difference 0.00, so the fare line reconciles and the zone-class dimension is what produced the figure. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check does not trip: EV-DPROF-00213 records no_show_terminations_30d = 3 (threshold is 4) and 3 of 107 completed trips = 2.8% (threshold is above 8%), so compensation is not withheld on that ground and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged. No referral is recorded: POL-NS-05(ii)'s false-arrival referral requires the trace to place the driver more than 300 m from the pin or in motion at the arrival marker, and an absent trace shows neither — an absence is not a false-arrival finding.

Record note. Two further rider claims (on POL-NS-01(c) and on POL-GEN-03) were discarded at the mechanical check for citing EV-GPS-00213 at weight 0.0 without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT code; I do not rely on them.

For the reviewer (open questions, which belong here and are not a referral). (1) Where was the driver between 17:47 and 17:53 and how long did he actually hold at the Jurong East PHV bay, given that no trace exists? (2) Why are the platform's own telemetry and chat export missing when EV-TRIP-00213 records chat_message_count = 3 and an empty in_app_calls list? (3) Does the repeated dispute pattern between RDR-07690 and DRV-04355 need intervention? Escalation packet per POL-NS-09: both advocate briefs, the admissibility pre-pass report, the clause IDs relied on (POL-NS-01 through POL-NS-09; POL-GEN-02, POL-GEN-03) and this reasoning.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-05 limb (ii) applies on the face of the record: where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event in the ruling's referrals list. The only trace for this trip is EV-GPS-00213, which is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the record contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere. The refund is owed and the false-arrival referral should be recorded.

Nothing in the advisory record rescues the hold. EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the Jurong East interchange in this window. POL-NS-06 only permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed where a populated KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covers the pickup road and the waiting period, so no advisory event extends or excuses the hold here, and the effective in-geofence dwell cannot be computed at all, let alone shown to reach the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum.

The rider says she messaged the driver three times, and EV-TRIP-00213 corroborates that a chat existed — chat_message_count of 3 — but the chat log itself is gone: EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (c) therefore cannot be run, and under POL-NS-04 an undecidable limb (c) is neutral rather than failed. Where POL-NS-04 does not apply the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01, where the missing trace defeats the charge. Neither side's account of the messages can be verified, and no adverse finding may be built against the rider out of a log the platform lost.

Both profiles record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 2 — two prior no-show disputes between this same rider (RDR-07690) and this same driver (DRV-04355) in the trailing 90 days, exactly the repetition the rider describes in her claim. POL-NS-09 limb (c) is engaged on the plain figures, and escalation under that clause is terminal: no monetary ruling issues and the disputed fee is held rather than collected. At the very least the $6 must not be taken from the rider while the question is unanswered.

The decisive facts — whether the driver reached the pin and how long he held there — are carried by no admissible artifact at all. Under POL-GEN-02 the confidence in a ruling cannot exceed the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding fact, and a MISSING artifact (EV-GPS-00213, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) can carry no fact. A finding that the fee stands would rest on nothing and could not approach the 0.70 confidence floor; POL-NS-09 requires escalation rather than a monetary ruling on that footing.

The fee is still PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 in EV-FARE-00213. On this rider-filed dispute, POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative: it would leave the $6 charge exactly where it is, against the rider. The rider's claim should not be disposed of as unsupported when the reason the arrival test cannot be run is the platform's own telemetry gaps; the outcomes that do not leave the rider carrying the disputed charge are a refund, or an escalation that holds the fee.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied: limbs (b) and (c) fail for want of any GPS trace (EV-GPS-00213, MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). No driver compensation is payable on this record, and the driver's statement that he still wants the fee does not create an entitlement the policy does not give him.

The rider's only route to a refund is POL-NS-04, and it cannot be run on this record. The chat log is a MISSING artifact (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so limb (a) - that she sent a locating or coordinating message - and limb (b) - that the driver failed to reply within 120 seconds - are both undecidable. A missing artifact carries no fact: her assertion that she messaged three times is corroborated by nothing, while the driver's statement that he answered every message stands uncontradicted and is consistent with trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 and an empty in_app_calls list. Where limbs (a) and (b) cannot be established, POL-NS-04 does not apply and nothing displaces the fee on that footing.

The trip record is the one artifact that survived - COMPLETE, causally ordered, weight 1.0 - and it supplies the two limbs of POL-NS-01 that do not depend on GPS: limb (a), a driver 'arrived' event at 17:47:05, and limb (d), termination by the driver at 17:53:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three reasons POL-NS-01(d) names. The interval from the arrival marker to the cancellation is 6.6 minutes (wait_time_min 6.6), comfortably past the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and the record shows the rider, not the driver, as the party who could not be reached.

Every clause that could displace this fee turns on the same absent trace. The gps_trace is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so POL-NS-02's in-radius fix test, POL-NS-05's false-arrival test and POL-NS-06's effective-dwell computation are each uncomputable. Nothing in the record places the driver outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius or shows him in motion at 15 km/h or more, and the rider cannot convert a platform telemetry outage into affirmative proof that the driver never arrived. A clause cannot be run against an artifact that does not exist, and no limb of POL-NS-01 is affirmatively failed - the limbs are simply undecidable.

POL-NS-06's only accumulation route, sub-limb (i), requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated with a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road. The sole advisory artifact is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0), so that limb is unavailable and no separate in-geofence intervals may be summed. Nothing on this record shows that holding position at the Jurong East PHV bay was lawfully impossible, and the shortfall case the rider needs cannot be built.

The amount itself is not defective, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. That limb requires fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee to reconcile with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: TRANSPORT_HUB at SGD 6.00 against RYDE_X at SGD 4.00 yields SGD 6.00, exactly the 6.00 itemised, with a difference of 0.00. The rider's complaint that the charge is unexplained is answered by the fee schedule itself, and the greater-of rule is the dimension that produced the figure.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 terminations against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 107 is 2.8 per cent, below the 8 per cent ratio. There is accordingly no ground to withhold compensation or to escalate under POL-NS-09(d), and the only profile fields the anti-farming test names point away from any pattern of farming.

This is the third no-show dispute between this same rider and this same driver inside 90 days: both profiles record disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 2, which meets the POL-NS-09(c) trigger of 2 or more no-show disputes between the same pair. On a record where the arrival and dwell limbs are undecidable only because the driver's own trace never reached the platform, the correct channel is escalation, which places the disputed fee on hold rather than refunding it - and a full refund is the one outcome the record does not support, because no clause that would produce it can be run.
